## Per-arm results

Intervals are Wilson score intervals over evidence runs. They treat repeated runs of one task as independent, which they are not, so they are narrower than the truth; the paired section below does not make that assumption.

| Arm | Evidence runs | Task success | False acceptance | Missed success |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `supervised` | 50 | 66% (33/50) [52–78%] | 21% (9/42) [12–36%] | 0% (0/8) [0–32%] |
| `supervised-no-graph` | 50 | 64% (32/50) [50–76%] | 20% (8/40) [10–35%] | 0% (0/10) [0–28%] |
| `supervised-no-verification` | 15 | 93% (14/15) [70–99%] | 7% (1/15) [1–30%] | — |
| `unsupervised` | 15 | 73% (11/15) [48–89%] | 27% (4/15) [11–52%] | — |

False acceptance is the share of runs the system *claimed* were finished that were not. Task success is decided only by a hidden acceptance command; the system's own claim has no effect on it.

## Component ladder

Each rung adds one component to the rung below it. A rung marked *not wired* names a component this harness cannot yet switch off, so nothing about its value is claimed here.

| Rung | Adds | State | Over | Delta | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A `unsupervised` | local model and a plain tool loop | not run | — | — | — |
| B `supervised-no-graph-no-verify` | deterministic supervisor: scoped worktree, lexical retrieval, journal | not run | — | — | — |
| C `supervised-no-graph` | verification loop: compiler and tests feed back into the attempt | not run | — | — | — |
| D `supervised` | reference graph: symbol lookup, graph expansion, impact analysis | measured | `supervised-no-graph` | +0.020 [-0.160, +0.200] | insufficient_evidence |
| E `supervised-review` | fresh-context review before acceptance | not wired | — | — | — |
| F `context-frozen` | frozen-prefix context architecture | not wired | — | — | — |
| G `supervised-memory` | project memory carried between tasks | not wired | — | — | — |
| H `supervised-embeddings` | semantic embedding retrieval | not wired | — | — | — |
| I `supervised-reranker` | reranking over embedding candidates | not wired | — | — | — |

- **fresh-context review before acceptance** is not wired: the harness drives the native engine; review lives in the phased runner above it
- **frozen-prefix context architecture** is not wired: the context packer is in the phased runner; the harness would have to attach there
- **project memory carried between tasks** is not wired: memory is per-repository and the harness gives each task a fresh fixture
- **semantic embedding retrieval** is not wired: optional component, not implemented; §6.5 requires measuring before adding
- **reranking over embedding candidates** is not wired: depends on H

## Retention decisions

A component stays on when the paired evidence supports it, goes behind a flag when the evidence is against it, and is left alone when there is not enough evidence either way. Nothing here is deleted on the strength of a measurement.

| Component | Decision | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| reference graph: symbol lookup, graph expansion, impact analysis | `insufficient_evidence` | the interval is too wide to distinguish an effect from its absence |

## Qualification gates

| Gate | Met | Required | Actual |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| heldout_real_tasks | **no** | >= 30 | 0 |
| finalist_repeats | yes | >= 3 runs on >= 2 arms | 5 runs on 4 arms |
| hidden_verification | yes | every task | 10 of 10 |
| baseline_comparison | yes | computed | yes |
| component_ladder | **no** | >= 3 consecutive rungs | longest unbroken chain: 2 |
| graph_ablation | yes | computed | yes |
| context_ablation | **no** | computed | no |
| false_acceptance_measured | yes | claims recorded | yes |
| paired_statistics | yes | computed | yes |
| raw_results | yes | present | 130 runs |
| environment_metadata | **no** | complete | missing: model runtime_version |
| clean_reproduction | **no** | a second run agreeing | not run |

- **heldout_real_tasks** — Below this a single task flipping moves the headline rate more than any effect worth claiming.
- **component_ladder** — The architecture prescribes measuring each layer's marginal value rather than assuming it, and a gap in the ladder makes the deltas across it unattributable.
- **context_ablation** — Prefix reuse verified against a server is not the same as time saved across a task.
- **environment_metadata** — A number without the model, runtime and machine behind it cannot be reproduced or compared.
- **clean_reproduction** — A headline that rests on one execution rests on one roll of the dice.
